title: Antique Brass Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount, Que New Collection Bath Towel Bar/Holder/Rail, Allied Brass
description:
Keep towels dry, visible, and easy to grab with a wall-mounted towel bar that adds organized storage to your bathroom in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. This bath towel bar (also called a towel rack, towel holder, or towel rail) is part of the Que New collection, designed to coordinate with matching Que New accessories for a cohesive, transitional bathroom.

Highlights:
- Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Maintain a clean look on the wall with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Save space with a wall mount, wall-mounted, wall hanging installation style
- Coordinate transitional bath accessories with Que New collection styling and grooved bathroom hardware-inspired detailing

Specs & Installation:
- Center-to-center: 30 in
- Bar diameter: 0.5 in
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount (concealed screw mount)
- Assembly required: false
- Included items: towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
